purpose: Teach: 誓い/あれだけ/家内/伯父/和室/帰れる/仕立て/籠

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、優勝するって、絶対、誓い、絶対、立てたよな?本気で
lines.en: Riku—you seriously swore you'd win no matter what, right?
lines.style: Direct, leaning in with genuine curiosity. Sharp attack on his name. Insistent rhythm—almost teasingly redundant with the repetition. Testing him, but not unkindly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、あれだけ、絶対、練習したのに、絶対、ヤバいぜ、桜
lines.en: You practiced that much and it's still falling apart. That's pretty bad, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry half-laugh underlying the words. Flat delivery with a subtle shrug in the voice. Self-deprecating deflection masking actual worry. Keep it light but let the concern show underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のご、本気で、絶対、家内、絶対、お元気?本気で
lines.en: How's your family doing, Riku? I'm asking seriously.
lines.style: Softer than before. The 'seriously' lands gently, not as a challenge but as reassurance that she's asking because she actually wants to know. Warm, steady eye contact in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、伯父、絶対、さん、絶対、教師なんだろ?桜
lines.en: Your uncle's a teacher, right, Sakura? I thought so.
lines.style: Observational, almost conversational. Quiet confidence—he's piecing something together. Not quite asking, more confirming what he already suspects. Gentle probe.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、和室、絶対、行ったの?本気で
lines.en: Did you end up going to your grandma's traditional room, Riku?
lines.style: Curious but grounded. No performance in the question. Direct interest, like she's checking in on something that mattered. Straightforward warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、もう、本気で、絶対、帰れる、絶対、んだろ?桜
lines.en: You'll be able to go home soon, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter now. The question carries a small weight—not heavy, but present. Hoping the answer is yes. Patient, like he's asking something that matters more than he's letting on.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の制服、本気で、絶対、仕立て、絶対、いいよね
lines.en: Your school uniform fits you really well, Riku.
lines.style: Simple observation, genuine. No flirtation, no performance—just noticing and saying it. Warmth without awkwardness. Let the compliment land plainly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、籠、絶対、にお弁当、絶対、ぎっしりだな、桜
lines.en: You packed your lunch box so full it's bursting, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry affection. Slight smile in the tone—catching him noticing her care. Not mocking, but gently teasing the abundance of it. Light, knowing.
